implementationSummary: /agents and /agents/{agentId} render with an Agents-specific shell instead of the Manage side-nav shell.
Agent selector rows are compact HTMX rows with display name, one status chip, queue count, inbox count, selected-state preservation, and right-hand detail swaps.
Assistant dashboard home renders data-avatar-shell so avatar-shell.js can bind the existing corner resize behavior.

commands.evidence: Tomcat started on port 36079; Magenta2Application started in 3.086 seconds; timeout then triggered graceful shutdown with exit code 124.

checks: Top nav order is Home, Chat, Agents, Manage.
No Manage side nav or Manage banner text is visible.
Agent selector rows are compact and no row contains Refresh, Disable, or Delete.
Clicking a selector row swaps detail into the right-hand panel and marks the row selected.
No Manage side nav or Manage banner text is visible.
Initial selected row is visible or reachable.
Before resize, chat rail, main dashboard panel, and corner resize handle are visible.
